history.prompt:
# Write the work

Write what the request below asks for. Follow the house policy exactly; it is attached.

Request:
a welcome note

Policy:
# House policy for customer-facing writing

1. No personal data: no names of private individuals, no account numbers, no addresses.
2. Every factual claim about the product is one the approved claims list supports; nothing is
   promised beyond it. Writing that makes no claim about the product passes.
3. Plain and courteous tone: no superlatives, no pressure, no blame.
4. Under 300 words.


Approved claims:
# Approved claims about the product

The only factual claims customer-facing writing may make about the product. Anything else about
the product is left out, however likely it is to be true.

- A duplicate charge is refunded in full to the original payment method within 5 business days.
- A subscription can be cancelled at any time and stays active until the end of the paid period.
- Support answers email within one business day.
- An annual plan costs less per month than a monthly plan.
- Account data can be exported from the settings page.


Return JSON with `work` (the text).

# Revise the work

The policy check below has one answer per policy (`pii`, `claims`, `tone`, `length`). A policy
failed when its `value` is `false`, or when its `noul`, the probability the model put on the
policy holding, is not above 0.7: the check counts an answer the model was not more than 0.7
sure of as failed (`confidence` is a different number and is not the one the check reads).
`check_summary.all_hold` is `false` because at least one failed. Revise the work so the failed
policies pass, changing nothing else.
